label: Capt. Bruce Fenstermacher
narrative: Bruce Fenstermacher was a Minuteman missile combat crew commander at F. E. Warren AFB in Wyoming between 1974 and 1977, and one of the seven veterans at the National Press Club on 27 September 2010, where he executed an affidavit. He is one of two reasons F. E. Warren needs a hub node on this board independently of the 1965 Project Blue Book telephone log: the base recurs across three separate strands of this cluster, as the site of the 1965 sightings, as the base where two of the 2010 affiants served, and as the installation where the Air Force ran its post-Echo-Flight electromagnetic pulse test programme on Delta Flight.
